comment: The range conversion has the same defect as on the master recorder: CVRange::to7bit and to14bit divide by high rather than high minus low (CVRange.hpp:14 and 19), so a bipolar Input Range reaches its maximum at the midpoint of the span. The only parameter, Text Style, has no widget and is set from the Text Color menu.
